explication: SuiteCRM 7 is a self-hosted customer relationship management application. Its broad user-to-result path is a web request handled by the application/controller layer, operating on CRM records and returning a view or API response. The repository also contains substantial search, access control, module installation, reporting, and calendar synchronization capabilities. The graph preserves those branches and core persistence/search layers; several connections are dashed because the supplied excerpts do not show their runtime wiring.
